# `company.party_merges`

Customer and vendor merges: each merged-away entry and the survivor it reads as.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this merge. |
| `party_kind` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | ix_party_merges_live_survivor, ux_party_merges_live_merged | — | List the two entries belong to: customer or vendor. |
| `merged_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ux_party_merges_live_merged | — | Entry merged away; hidden and resolved to the survivor while the merge stands. |
| `survivor_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_party_merges_live_survivor | — | Entry the merged one now reads as. |
| `deactivated_merged` | BOOLEAN | no | — | — | — | — | Whether the merge made the merged entry inactive, so an undo makes it active again. |
| `reason` | VARCHAR(500) | no | — | — | — | — | Why the person merged the two entries. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp of the merge. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Person who merged the entries. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface the merge came through. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event of the merge. |
| `undone_at` | VARCHAR(32) | yes | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp the merge was undone; null while it stands. |
| `undone_by` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | Person who undid the merge; null while it stands. |
| `undone_via` | VARCHAR(16) | yes | — | — | — | — | Interface the undo came through; null while it stands. |
| `undo_reason` | VARCHAR(500) | yes | — | — | — | — | Why the merge was undone; null while it stands. |
| `undo_audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event of the undo; null while it stands. |
